Description: Infection of susceptible individuals through contact with individuals in any of the infectious compartments.
Quarantine of exposed individuals identified via contact tracing.
Progression from the latent period to the presymptomatic infectious stage.
Progression from the quarantined latent period to the isolated presymptomatic infectious stage.
Onset of mild to moderate symptoms.
Onset of severe symptoms.
Onset of mild to moderate symptoms in an isolated individual.
Onset of severe symptoms in an isolated individual.
Isolation of individuals with mild to moderate symptoms following testing.
Recovery of individuals with mild to moderate infection.
Recovery of isolated individuals with mild to moderate infection.
Isolation of individuals with severe symptoms following testing.
Hospitalization of severe cases.
Hospitalization of isolated severe cases that will require ICU care.
Recovery of hospitalized cases that did not require ICU care.
Admission to the ICU from a hospital ward.
Discharge from the ICU to a hospital ward for continued care.
Death of cases in the ICU.
Recovery after being discharged from the ICU and receiving post-ICU hospital care.

Name: Latent period
Description: Time from exposure to onset of infectiousness.

Name: Presymptomatic infectious period
Description: Duration of infectiousness before symptom onset.

Name: Infectious period (mild to moderate)
Description: Symptomatic infectious period for mild-to-moderate cases (in absence of isolation).

Name: Infectious period (severe)
Description: Symptomatic infectious period for severe cases; assumed equal to time to hospital admission.

Name: Basic reproduction number
Description: Average number of secondary infections derived from a primary infection in a susceptible population.

Name: Time in quarantine
Description: Duration of quarantine for exposed cases.

Name: Relative risk of transmission for cases in isolation
Description: Transmission reduction for isolated cases relative to unrecognized cases.

Name: Average length of stay in hospital for cases not requiring ICU care
Description: Duration of stay for hospitalized cases not requiring ICU.

Name: Average length of stay in hospital before ICU admission
Description: Duration of stay in hospital for severe cases before they are admitted to the ICU.

Name: Average length of stay in ICU
Description: Duration of stay for cases in the ICU.

Name: Average length of stay in hospital after ICU
Description: Duration of stay in hospital for cases after being discharged from the ICU.

Name: Probability of severe infection
Description: Probability that an infection is severe, requiring hospital admission.
Value: Varies by age and comorbidity (e.g., 0.01 for <15 with no comorbidities, 0.76 for >=70 with comorbidities)

Name: Probability severe case requires admission to ICU
Description: Probability that a severe case requires admission to the ICU.

Name: Probability of death in cases admitted to ICU
Description: Probability of death for cases admitted to the ICU.
Value: Varies by age and comorbidity (e.g., 0 for <15, 1 for >=70 with comorbidities)

Name: Proportion of nonquarantined cases tested and isolated (Base Case)
Description: Proportion of symptomatic, non-quarantined individuals who are tested and moved to an isolated compartment (Base Case).

Name: Proportion of exposed cases quarantined (Base Case)
Description: Proportion of exposed cases who are identified and enter quarantine before becoming infectious (Base Case).

Name: Reduction in contacts with physical distancing (Base Case)
Description: Reduction in contact rates due to physical distancing measures (Base Case).
